source_revision_policy: The exact published frozen head containing this plan; no mutable branch image or unrelated fixture.

cost.unknown_policy: STOP before cloud build or experiment; do not infer headroom from old delayed billing snapshots.

steps.requires: Before the literal publication command, run sha256sum -c on the v3 input manifest and current-source manifest. Then require clean exact listed inputs/index and an immutable GitHub publication receipt; retain its SHA. The authenticated workflow checks out the exact immutable revision into a fresh tree.

Current authorized account and lane headroom with charged/reserved costs, timestamp and current price/budget envelope; this information is unavailable and has been requested by connection/runner name. Unknown is not approval.

Publication and current budget/headroom gates pass before paid storage/transfer. Trusted workflow on main; existing temporary identity; actual source/spec/protocol/archive upload/readback hashes. Templates are not an executed command receipt.
Publication, checkpoint/readback and budget gates pass; retain actual workflow/build/binary/OCI identities and all costs. No scientific submission in publish-only mode.

All prior gates and current budget headroom still pass; the maintained path rebuilds/publishes and must admit that final exact image before submitting the one native L2 job. Retain original IDs, no duplicate after ambiguity.

Keep every failed/exhausted/interrupted outcome and raw S3 object, native L2/replay/A/A/hash admissions and missing counters. Write bench.record/v1 plus canonical export/progress/PCC records. No complete comparison from incomplete arms, no execution-verification claim without signed standing.
